name: Accessibility Audit
description: Example skill that reviews a web interface for keyboard access, semantic structure, focus behavior, and contrast risks.

installation.notes: This catalog entry demonstrates the expected metadata shape; its example source is intentionally kept in this repository.

usage.instructions: Ask your coding assistant to audit a named page or component and provide the relevant source files and interaction requirements.
usage.example: Audit the checkout form for WCAG 2.2 AA keyboard and labeling issues. Prioritize blockers and suggest focused fixes.
